retraction.reason: Retracted in M22: the local elections of 26 September 2021, at which the Socialists won nationally and lost Lisbon. The atlas keeps the first exercise of an institution and the ballot at which it became a cycle, and retracts the routine repetitions after them; the twelfth local election is one. The only link available is the constitutional one the earlier records already carry. Revisit if a consequence is written.
